reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code answer my first question, whether it is actually tested. Sachets are easy to throw in my bag when I travel, and $24.99 for the first box is low enough to try once on impulse.
objection: A lab report on their own page is still their word. I would want to see that the lab is real and that the number on the box matches what is in the capsule. I also don't know if I will feel anything from magnesium.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out to be a generic one that is not tied to the batch number on the box, or if the price were back at $29.99 with no launch discount, I would probably skip it.
